name: The Easternmost Valley
description: The first place Yanggu can remember, after which he named himself.

timeline.summary: Yanggu names himself after the Easternmost Valley, the first place he remembers.
timeline.quote: He decided to call himself Yanggu, meaning “the valley where sun rises,” after the first place he can remember
